name: Node.js
description: Node.js lets you run JavaScript on the server and in automation scripts. This path covers core runtime features, file-based data, testing, and a mini project flow.

snippets.title: Project Structure for a Node Learning Workspace
snippets.codeDes: Keep runtime code and command-line scripts separate so examples scale into real tools.
snippets.code:
node-lab/
  src/
    server.js
    routes.js
    repo/taskRepo.js
    worker/reminderWorker.js
  scripts/
    task-cli.js
  data/
    tasks.json
  tests/
    routes.test.js
  package.json

snippets.title: Initialize Project and Helpful Scripts
snippets.codeDes: Set modern defaults and scripts for development and tests.
snippets.code:
npm init -y
npm pkg set type=module
npm pkg set scripts.dev="node --watch src/server.js"
npm pkg set scripts.start="node src/server.js"
npm pkg set scripts.test="node --test"

snippets.title: Build a JSON API with node:http (src/server.js)
snippets.codeDes: Start with the built-in http module to understand fundamentals before frameworks.

snippets.title: File-Based Repository (src/repo/taskRepo.js)
snippets.codeDes: Use fs/promises to keep persistence simple for learning projects.

snippets.title: Simple Route Handler (src/routes.js)
snippets.codeDes: Route manually to understand request parsing and response writing.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Task CLI Command Parser (scripts/task-cli.js)
snippets.codeDes: Small project idea: maintain tasks from the terminal. Parse commands and reuse repo logic.

snippets.title: Mini Project: Reminder Worker (src/worker/reminderWorker.js)
snippets.codeDes: Background loops are useful for automation, cron replacements, and polling jobs.

snippets.title: Test a Route with node:test (tests/routes.test.js)
snippets.codeDes: Use the built-in test runner for quick feedback without external tooling.

snippets.title: Run Server, CLI, Worker, and Tests
snippets.codeDes: Use these commands while practicing runtime, automation, and verification.
snippets.code:
npm run dev
node scripts/task-cli.js add "Write docs"
node src/worker/reminderWorker.js
npm test

snippets.title: Next Learning Upgrades
snippets.codeDes: Use this list to evolve your Node snippets into production-quality patterns.
snippets.code:
1. Add schema validation with zod before saving tasks.
2. Add structured logging and correlation IDs.
3. Move data from JSON file storage to PostgreSQL.
4. Add graceful shutdown for server and workers.
5. Add integration tests against real HTTP endpoints.
